note: Campground at the Fall River County Fairgrounds in Edgemont, run by the volunteer fair board: a row of about ten RV sites along a gravel apron on the east side of the grounds. The grounds also host the county fair (late July) and other events. Convenient southern Black Hills base. --Claude
summary: Fair site's contact page (2026): full hookup $40 nightly / $200 weekly / $500 monthly, electric-only $30, long-term/monthly sites available, reserve by phone/text; fairgrounds privately owned by the fair board. Fees $30 (stored none) -> 30-40, booking platform phone, hookups water/sewer confirmed; note cleaned of the stale $30/$20 rates. Ordinary nights are sold outside the fair. Ownership and long-stay flags. Pin fine, not waterfront.
flags: OWNERSHIP (reviewer): the fair's own page says 'The fair grounds are privately owned and operated by the Fall River County Fair, Board of Directors, and works independently from any governmental agency, receiving no public funding of any kind.' On the non-profit rule (Wabash & Erie) that is `private`; on the recent 'a fair association's campground stays local' lesson it stays `local`. Left local. If made private: price gate passes (electric-only $30, full hookup $40 a night, no gateway needed); presence passes (working site + phone 605.662.5100; Google listing, no rating shown).
FAIRGROUNDS / ORDINARY NIGHTS: shown - the campground posts nightly, weekly and monthly rates with a reservation contact independent of event dates; the 2027 fair runs Jul 28-Aug 1.

LONG-STAY: '* LONG TERM/MONTHLY RV SITES AVAILABLE *' (monthly $500). The nightly share is unmeasured (no booking engine; ~10 pads visible on imagery). The nightly rate is posted, so test 2 passes; nothing says nightly guests are discouraged.
SEASON: the page states no season; stored year_round true (derived from note prose) left as is, unconfirmed.
HOOKUPS: amperage not posted. Site count not posted (~10 pads on imagery; the old note's '~10 full-hookup sites' is unsourced).

PHONE 605-662-5100 confirmed ('ph: 605.662.5100 (msg)'; text line 307.202.9615). WEBSITE https://fallrivercountyfair.com/ is the operator's site; the camping rates are on https://fallrivercountyfair.com/contact-us - suggest that page instead.
NOTE: old note's '$30/night ($150/week, $450/month) plus electric-only sites at $20/night' is out of date (now $40/$200/$500 and $30) and is dropped; rates live in fees.
